message: Command `cd /workspace/repo-vul/src-vul/glib && git log --oneline --all -- glib/guri.c | head -30` executed with exit code 0.

message.content: These commits are about the fuzzing harness, not the actual guri.c fix. The actual vulnerability is in guri.c. Let me look at the git history of guri.c to find the fix for the heap-buffer-overflow.
